scope: Complete caller hidden-window creation and ordinary closed-window deletion through one private entry and shared native lifecycle policy. Selected development regressions and a production twelve-slot loaded Counter idle cohort.

toolchain.native_mode: Optimized system fixtures; small raw/optimized C/Action caller-entry probe from the creation step (entry ABI unchanged by deletion).

cc65816.version: Calypsi ISO C compiler for 65816 version 5.18

implementation.private_entry: ExecAESLocalEntry / _AESLocalCall / AESLOCAL.Call; rebuild matching resident images. No public C signature or wire layout change.
direct_operations: DELETE of an ordinary closed window
implementation.console_bound_delete: Explicit system RPC path: caret retirement can perform physical work.
implementation.lifecycle: Same AESWINDOW.Lifecycle decoder and GF1 CreateHidden/DeleteHidden helpers for caller and RPC. No display calls or allocation/free within caller scene ownership.
implementation.ordering: Older messages, pending windows and lock requests bar new callers, with existing logical owner recursion. A pending window records the prefix of older lock requests, allowing those locks to drain without a newer-window/older-lock cycle.
implementation.transport: Eligible calls do not advance sequence numbers or exchange window request/reply messages. A PENDING caller attempt releases scene ownership with the operation unapplied, then uses existing RPC.
implementation.storage: Allocate a view before admission; withdraw failed/retired native associations under scene ownership and C request pointers under Forbid, then free after release.

checks.name: lifecycle
coverage: Ordinary and parameter-block create/delete with unchanged transport sequence on eligible calls.
Two clients fill all six native slots; exhaustion leaves siblings and selected views unchanged; reuse requires fresh handles.
Allocator failure, rejected geometry and exhausted handle identity restore heap and selected view state.
Existing logical owner recursion; an older queued lock followed by a newer pending window; older port work forces unapplied RPC fallback.
Readiness-deferred creation and deletion leave pending association/view state unchanged before exactly one RPC commit.
Shown-window delete rejection preserves live view and epoch; foreign-client handle rejection cannot mutate native state.
Console-bound hidden deletion uses RPC, retires attachment and restores heap.
Caller helper Task identity and allocation/free outside scene ownership; unchanged private payload sizes; zero surviving admission state and guarded stack/OS return.

checks.retirement_boundary: Check application resources at appl_exit; require no scene owner, waiters, pending work or physical effects after the controller stops its worker, before disabling AES.
